start: Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough

lines.card: Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough

lines.text: Get To Your Ships (because it is the same as squassin, but there are some people in the world who don't know what it does, not many, but what the heck)
Chewie w/Gun (no upkeep, great trackable destiny in this deck so i actually can hit stuff with his gun, and he is a backup for the falcon in a pinch)
Leebo (backup for Artoo's hyperdrive capabilities, matching pilot for Outrider, Direct Damage, smuggler)
R. Ryjerd V (doubles and pulls Kessel Run)
R2 D2 V (adds three to hyperspeed, allowing 1 turn kessel runs w/ship-docking)
2x Luke's sitck (very important, as luke is like the only solid ground charachter in this deck)
2x Luke's Back V (IMO, the most underrated card in the game. if you do not know EVERTYTHING this card does, look it up.)
Hyper Escape (can you think of anything funnier happening in a game than keesel running to complete a Kessel Run?)
2x Fallen Portal (if they are playing heavy ground attacking forces, move luke to the DB, and play these)
3x How Did We Get Into This Mess (hand Control & tracking setup)
lines.card: How Did We Get Into This Mess?

lines.text: We're doomed (if they don't grab anything else, they will be in trouble with the wide arrange ment of int's. If they do grab something else, this card will shut them down in the end.  with menace fades and this,. For instance, you can limit a deal deck with dealand CC occupation out to 4 damage a turn)
Inconsequential Barriers (because chu showed me at worlds it is a good idea to be able to cancel set for stun)

lines.card: Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency

lines.text: 2x AWRI & Darklighter spin (with my maneuver 11 Falcon)
lines.card: All Wings Report In & Darklighter Spin

lines.text: 3x Kessel Run (with R. Ryjerd and Melas on Pulsar skate, you can retrieve as much as 22 in one turn, by ship docking Melas and r2)

notes: "This is the deck that I got 2nd at MN states with (and went 2-2 at worlds day 2, losing to Chu by 15 and Pistone by 2)" — also 2003 World Championship Day 2. Posted 7 Mar 2004.
